records.claim: Studies have not been done to see if clindamycin could affect men’s fertility (ability to make healthy sperm) or increase the chance of birth defects. In general, exposures that fathers or sperm donors have are unlikely to increase the risks to a pregnancy. For more information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/.
records.source_section: If a man takes clindamycin, could it affect fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
